newsitem.title: FRANCE: DHL to take 5pct stake in Ducros Rapides.
newsitem.headline: DHL to take 5pct stake in Ducros Rapides.

text.p: French parcel delivery operator Ducros Services Rapides said DHL Worldwide Express is to take a shareholding of around five percent in the company.
At DHL's headquaters in Brussels, an official told Reuters the company would not be making an official statement until later this month.
DHL's shareholding in Ducros will form part of a programme to raise 70 million francs of new equity on the French stock exchange from October 17, a Ducros official told Reuters.
Italian parcel delivery company, Mazzoni, is also to take a minority shareholding in Ducros, probably about three percent, the official said.
Financial investors will have an 18 to 27 percent shareholding in the recapitalised Ducros.
Overall control continuing to be held by French holding group, Cofimat, with between 50 and 60 percent of the company's capital.

DHL is also currently the German partner for the European 48-72 hour road express distribution service, Europolitan, via its subsidiary, Elan Rindt and also ships traffic on behalf of the French company in Scandinavia.

Mazzoni, in which Ducros has a minority stake, is the Italian partner for Europolitan. Ducros tabled net losses for first half 1996 interim of 24.9 million francs. This compares to full 1995 net losses of 129.2 million francs.
Main shareholders in DHL are Deustche Lufthansa AG and Japan Airlines Co Ltd, which each hold a 25 percent stake.
